tagline: The leading digital platform for U.S. medical professionals
hero_kpi_rationale: AI-powered workflow tools represent the primary driver of growth and user engagement, as they directly capture the integration of generative AI into physicians' daily clinical workflows, enhancing productivity and retention.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company in a year from its services.
kpis.description: Revenue is growing strongly, driven by Marketing, Hiring, and Workflow solutions. Growth of 20% in 2025 following 13% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Sustained double-digit growth supported by customer loyalty and expansion.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income increased by 51% in 2025, rising from $147.6M to $223.2M, reflecting strong improvement in profitability.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in profitability driven by scale effects.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, adjusted for certain costs.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA reached $313.8M in 2025, up 36% from $230.5M in 2024.

kpis.name: Net Revenue Retention
kpis.explanation: Measures how much revenue is retained and expanded from existing customers.
kpis.description: Net revenue retention was 119% in 2025, up from 114% in 2024, indicating strong cross-sell and up-sell expansion.
kpis.signal: Very high customer loyalty and expansion within existing customer base.

kpis.name: Active Users - Clinical Tools
kpis.explanation: Number of unique healthcare professionals actively using clinical workflow tools on the platform.
kpis.description: Over 620,000 unique medical professionals used clinical workflow tools in the quarter ended March 31, 2025, demonstrating broad adoption of productivity solutions including AI-powered tools.
kpis.signal: Widespread and growing adoption of workflow tools, particularly AI-powered solutions.

kpis.name: Large Customers (>500k$)
kpis.explanation: Number of customers generating more than $500,000 in annual revenue.
kpis.description: 116 customers generated over $500,000 in revenue over 12 months in 2025, compared to 99 in 2024. These customers represent 84% of total revenue.
kpis.signal: Revenue concentration among fast-growing strategic customers.

risks.title: Difficulty managing rapid growth
risks.score_rationale: The risk is listed first in the Risk Factors Summary and discussed at length. The language emphasizes significant strain on systems and management. Uneven revenue growth (20% in 2025 vs 13% in 2024) reinforces this risk.

risks.title: Limited operating history
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly identified as increasing investment risk. The language expresses concern over evaluation difficulty and uncertainties. Repeated in both summary and main text.

risks.title: Loss of members or low engagement
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described as potentially significantly harming revenues and financial health. It is central to multiple paragraphs and directly tied to revenue. The language is strong and repeated.

risks.title: Customer non-renewals
risks.score_rationale: The text states this could have a material negative impact on results. Absence of long-term contracts with pharma clients, uncertain renewals, and dependence on perceived solution effectiveness. The language is repeated and emphasized.

ai_positioning.summary: Doximity integrates artificial intelligence through AI-powered workflow tools, including an AI writing assistant, highlighted as central to the Workflow Solutions strategy and in the MD&A as drivers of growth and user engagement.
